themes.name: Persistent Gulf disruption and tight stocks
Diesel tightness and US export ban risk
Asian pull on Atlantic Basin crude / WTI-Brent

scenarios.label: US-Iran deal or direct talks announced, no strikes
scenarios.test_text: A fact sheet dated 2026-10-02..2026-10-09 reports that the US and Iran reached/signed an agreement or formally announced direct negotiations during Oct 1-9, and no US/Israeli strike on Iranian territory occurred in that window.

scenarios.label: Threats and buildup only; no strikes, no deal
scenarios.test_text: Neither the bearish nor the bullish condition is reported in fact sheets dated through 2026-10-09.

scenarios.label: US or Israeli strikes on Iran resume before Oct 9
scenarios.test_text: A fact sheet dated 2026-10-02..2026-10-09 reports a US or Israeli military strike on Iranian territory occurring between Oct 1 and Oct 9, 2026.

scenarios.label: Front Brent spread eases below $3
scenarios.test_text: brent_m1m2 on the last settlement on or before 2026-10-09 is below 3.00.

scenarios.label: Front Brent spread holds $3-5
scenarios.test_text: brent_m1m2 on the last settlement on or before 2026-10-09 is >= 3.00 and < 5.00.

scenarios.label: Front Brent spread widens to $5+
scenarios.test_text: brent_m1m2 on the last settlement on or before 2026-10-09 is >= 5.00.

scenarios.label: COF27 falls below $95
scenarios.test_text: brent_ref (COF27) on the last settlement on or before 2026-10-09 is below 95.00.

scenarios.label: COF27 holds $95-102
scenarios.test_text: brent_ref (COF27) on the last settlement on or before 2026-10-09 is >= 95.00 and < 102.00.

scenarios.label: COF27 at $102 or higher
scenarios.test_text: brent_ref (COF27) on the last settlement on or before 2026-10-09 is >= 102.00.

scenarios.label: US announces diesel export ban or formal restriction
scenarios.test_text: A fact sheet dated 2026-10-02..2026-10-09 reports the US government announced a ban, quota or licensing restriction on diesel/distillate exports during Oct 1-9.

scenarios.label: No US export restriction; ULSD stays below $5/gal
scenarios.test_text: Neither the bearish nor the bullish condition is reported in fact sheets dated through 2026-10-09.

scenarios.label: No restriction and NYMEX ULSD front settles >= $5.00/gal
scenarios.test_text: No bearish-condition announcement, and a fact sheet dated 2026-10-02..2026-10-09 reports a NYMEX front-month ULSD settle of $5.00/gal or higher.

scenarios.label: WTI-Brent widens below -$13
scenarios.test_text: wti_brent_m1 on the last settlement on or before 2026-10-09 is below -13.00.

scenarios.label: WTI-Brent between -$13 and -$10
scenarios.test_text: wti_brent_m1 on the last settlement on or before 2026-10-09 is >= -13.00 and < -10.00.

scenarios.label: WTI-Brent narrows to -$10 or tighter
scenarios.test_text: wti_brent_m1 on the last settlement on or before 2026-10-09 is >= -10.00.

scenarios.label: WTI front falls below $88
scenarios.test_text: wti_m1 on the last settlement on or before 2026-10-09 is below 88.00.

scenarios.label: WTI front holds $88-97
scenarios.test_text: wti_m1 on the last settlement on or before 2026-10-09 is >= 88.00 and < 97.00.

scenarios.label: WTI front at $97 or higher
scenarios.test_text: wti_m1 on the last settlement on or before 2026-10-09 is >= 97.00.
